title: Wingspan
content: Engine-building game about attracting birds to wildlife preserves. 1-5 players, ~70 minutes, medium weight. Great for families and strategy fans alike.

title: Azul
content: Abstract tile-drafting game about decorating palace walls. 2-4 players, ~40 minutes, light-medium. Simple rules, sharp decisions.

title: Gloomhaven
content: Massive cooperative dungeon-crawling campaign with legacy elements. 1-4 players, 90-150 minutes per scenario, heavy. A long-term commitment.

title: Codenames
content: Team word-association party game with spymasters giving one-word clues. 4-8+ players, ~15 minutes, light. The go-to party opener.

title: 7 Wonders Duel
content: Two-player card-drafting civilization game with three paths to victory. 2 players, ~30 minutes, medium. One of the best head-to-head games.

title: Pandemic
content: Cooperative game where players race to cure four diseases before outbreaks cascade. 2-4 players, ~45 minutes, medium-light. The classic co-op gateway.

title: Terraforming Mars
content: Heavy engine-builder about corporations making Mars habitable. 1-5 players, 120+ minutes, heavy. Deep card combos, science-fiction theme.

title: The Crew
content: Cooperative trick-taking game with escalating missions and limited communication. 3-5 players, ~20 minutes, light-medium. Quiet, tense, brilliant.

title: Cascadia
content: Tile-laying puzzle about building Pacific Northwest habitats for wildlife. 1-4 players, ~40 minutes, light-medium. Calm, clever, gorgeous.

title: Spirit Island
content: Complex cooperative game where island spirits repel colonizing invaders. 1-4 players, 90-120 minutes, heavy. The thinking player's co-op.
